summary: Validated backend product-edit workflows and ran targeted UI regression for the collapsible Product Edit redesign. Backend contracts passed; frontend flow is mostly verified but shipping custom-delivery toggle interaction blocked full completion of all requested UI behaviors in automation.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (attempts 1-6 all returned 401).
allow_credentials=true is paired with CORS_ORIGINS='*' (credentialed wildcard origin policy).

minor.issue: No app auth/session cookie observed; only Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie present.

ui_bugs.issue: Custom delivery window checkbox could not be reliably toggled in automation; min/max day inputs never appeared, blocking full verification of custom delivery edit behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Shipping custom window interaction blocked test continuation to full save+mobile completion in the same run.

action_items: Fix or expose a stable direct data-testid on the shipping custom-delivery checkbox input so toggle interaction is reliably testable and min/max fields render.
Re-run full Product Edit UI flow after shipping toggle fix to complete mobile overflow + sticky action assertions in a single green run.
Replace wildcard CORS origin when credentials are enabled (use explicit trusted origins).
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail section scaffold and defaults match requested redesign intent in code: basic/images/pricing true by default and variants/shipping/content/seo/promotions false by default.

Section wrappers and major controls include strong data-testid coverage, but the shipping custom-window checkbox input lacks its own dedicated testid; this reduces reliability for automation and accessibility-state targeting.
Auth hardening gaps remain in backend security posture: no lockout, wildcard credentialed CORS, and no server-managed auth session cookie for admin login.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (core section/default-state/state-retention checks passed; shipping toggle blocked remaining requested path)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_UI_LAYOUT_* products during UI runs and deleted each via API cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is green in /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iteration42_product_editor_backend.xml. UI attempts consistently blocked at Shipping custom-delivery toggle/min-max rendering path; avoid repeated selector churn and validate this interaction manually first, then rerun full mobile assertions.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Shipping custom-delivery path repeatedly failed in automation because checkbox interaction did not produce min/max inputs, despite section expansion and other controls working. This points to either click/state wiring fragility on the checkbox path or missing direct, stable test target for the input. RCA-2: Security policy issues are configuration/implementation-level (CORS '*' + credentials, absent brute-force throttling), reproducible via direct API checks.
